25a(i)

By definition, gravitational potential is zero at infinity. 

This means that a positive amount of work must be done on an object in order to reach infinity, hence gravitational potential is negative.

25b(iii)

A decrease in speed leads to a decrease in kinetic energy.

Since the total energy is the sum of the potential energy and the kinetic energy, a decrease in kinetic energy leads to a decrease in total energy (so total energy becomes more negative).

As a result, the asteroid moves closer to Venus, its orbital radius decreases and its orbital speed increases.

a. An asteroid orbits Venus at a distance of km from the surface of Venus.

i. Explain why the gravitational potential is negative.

  [2]

ii. Show that the magnitude of the asteroid's acceleration is approximately m s.

iii. Find the mass of Venus.

i. Find the distance of the asteroid from the surface of Venus.

ii. Calculate, in hours, the time it takes the asteroid to complete one full revolution about Venus.
